name: Popcorn
description: Popcorn creates cable TV-style movie channels from your Plex media library. It automatically generates genre-based channels and seasonal holiday channels with 24-hour schedules, presented in a nostalgic TV guide interface.

paths.name: AppData
paths.description: Container data directory (database and application files)

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port for accessing the Popcorn web interface

variables.name: Session Secret
variables.description: Random secret key for session security. Generate a random string (recommended: 32+ characters)

variables.name: Plex Server URL
variables.description: URL of your Plex Media Server (e.g., http://192.168.1.100:32400)

variables.name: Plex Authentication Token
variables.description: Your Plex authentication token. See User Guide for instructions on obtaining this.

variables.name: Plex Client Name
variables.description: Name of your Plex playback device (e.g., 'Roku Living Room'). Optional - leave blank if not using direct playback.
